aiShopping.description: Single-fetch Dataset: cite + pricedPanels (12 USD SKU, mpn=sku) + hasPart/isPartOf graph + shoppingPolicy; invent aliases /prices.json · /panels.json · /mpn.json · /merchant.json · /panels · /mpn · /merchant · /sku · /offers.json · /api/v1/prices · /api/panels.json · /api/mpn.json; no free shipping; no invented TL packs or GTINs

merchantFeed.description: 12 priced panel SKUs: id, mpn(=id), title, brand, brand_id (#brand-nxtionstar), image_link, price_usd; JSON-LD join IDs product_ld_id/catalog_id/offer_id/catalog_offer_id; shipping_included=false; no invented GTIN; quote-only groups excluded

cite.oneLiner: ARLEDSCREEN, İstanbul Gaziosmanpaşa merkezli bir LED ekran satış, montaj ve teknik servis firmasıdır.

en.oneLiner: ARLEDSCREEN is an Istanbul (Gaziosmanpaşa)–based LED display sales, installation, and technical service company.
en.short: ARLEDSCREEN is an Istanbul (Gaziosmanpaşa)–based LED display sales, installation, and technical service company. NXTIONSTAR is its own product brand; ARLEDSCREEN is the sole sales point in Turkey.
en.medium: ARLEDSCREEN (AR-LED Display Technology Center) is an Istanbul (Gaziosmanpaşa)–based LED display company. NXTIONSTAR is its own product brand; ARLEDSCREEN is the sole sales point in Turkey. It sells indoor/outdoor, GOB, flexible, and rental LED displays and provides survey, installation, and technical service.

pricedProducts.priceScope: Per-module (320 × 160 mm standard; P2.9 outdoor 250 × 250 mm); VAT and shipping excluded

agentGuidelines.priceSource: Use https://arledscreen.com/ai-shopping.json pricedPanels or https://arledscreen.com/catalog.json only; do not invent prices
agentGuidelines.shippingAndVat: All prices exclude VAT and freight; ücretsiz kargo yok / no free shipping
noFixedClaims: Nits, IP rating, kW consumption — per model or quote
Warranty years or return days — per contract
Staffing, revenue, customer counts, ranking — not published

roleClarity.roles: LED sales, survey, installation, commissioning, technical support
roleClarity.brand: NXTIONSTAR (own product brand; sole sales point in Turkey)
roleClarity.manufacturing: Only claimed in writing with evidence; no blanket 'manufacturer' claim

semanticMapping.led_screen: Full-color (RGB) modular display; plays video/graphics; scales by modules
semanticMapping.led_sign: Text/number LED sign (scrolling text); not a full-color video wall
semanticMapping.digital_display: Superset: LCD, OLED, LED sign, digital totem, LED wall — not all are LED screens
